name: openoutreach
description: An automation tool leveraging AI to find and generate leads on LinkedIn for outreach purposes. It helps businesses describe their product, define target markets, and automate lead identification to streamline lead generation workflows.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A description of the product or service to be promoted.

inputs.name: target_market_profile
inputs.description: Definition or criteria describing the ideal customer or market segment for lead generation.

inputs.name: LinkedIn_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication details or API tokens for accessing LinkedIn data.

inputs.name: search_parameters
inputs.description: Filters and parameters to refine lead search (e.g., industry, location, job titles).

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: A structured list of potential leads generated from LinkedIn based on input criteria.

outputs.name: automation_report
outputs.description: Summary report detailing the number of leads found, messages sent, and campaign status.

steps: User provides a detailed description of their product or service.
User defines their target market using criteria such as industry, role, and geography.
The AI analyzes inputs to generate search parameters and identifies relevant LinkedIn leads.
The tool uses LinkedIn credentials to fetch and filter potential leads.
A list of qualified leads is compiled and organized.
Automation processes may initiate outreach sequences or export lead data.
The system produces reports on lead generation performance and campaign progress.
use_cases: Businesses seeking to automate LinkedIn lead generation campaigns.
Sales teams requiring AI support to identify potential clients within specific markets.
Marketing professionals aiming to streamline and scale LinkedIn outreach.
Startups and SMEs needing targeted lead lists without manual research.
patterns: Automated lead discovery through AI-enhanced search criteria
Integration with social media platform APIs for data extraction
Workflow automation for outreach and lead nurturing

prompt_templates.name: define_product_and_target
prompt_templates.template: Describe your product: {product_description}. Define your target market: {target_market_profile}.

prompt_templates.name: generate_leads
prompt_templates.template: Find leads on LinkedIn for a product with description: {product_description} targeting: {target_market_profile}.

prompt_templates.name: summarize_campaign
prompt_templates.template: Provide a summary report for the LinkedIn outreach campaign including leads found and actions taken.
